test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Height of 6 girls P, Q, R, S, T and U is compared. Height of no two girls is same. R is taller than only four girls. U is taller than both S and P. S and P both are taller than both Q and T. Which of the following is a possible sequence of their heights?

I. U > R > S > P > T > Q 

II. U > R > P > S > Q > T
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

R is taller than only four girls.

Since, there are 6 girls in total, R must be the 2nd tallest.

U is taller than both S and P.

S and P both are taller than both Q and T.

So, the general order becomes: U > R > {S, P} > {Q, T}

Now check the given sequences.

I. U > R > S > P > T > Q

 2nd
 3rd
 4th
 5th
